# core-resource
tap id:case-core-resource
# Resources without a source: a value at once, an initial value while the
# first load runs, a fetcher that throws.
expect Now: ready 42
expect Kept: refreshing first loading
expect Thrown: errored Error: thrown
expect Child: pending
expect Child aborts: 0
# The first load runs, then ends.
expect State: pending
expect Value: none
expect Error: none
expect Loading: yes
expect Loads: 1
expect Aborts: 0
tap id:resolve
expect State: ready
expect Value: user 1
expect Loading: no
# A new source loads again, keeping the value; another one supersedes
# that load, which is aborted.
tap id:next
expect State: refreshing
expect Loading: yes
expect Loads: 2
expect Value: user 1
tap id:next
expect Loads: 3
expect Aborts: 1
expect State: refreshing
# The load fails: the value stays.
tap id:reject
expect State: errored
expect Error: Error: no user 3
expect Value: user 1
expect Loading: no
# A value set here clears the error.
tap id:mutate
expect State: ready
expect Value: local
expect Error: none
# A refetch loads the same source again, and the fetcher knows.
tap id:refetch
expect State: refreshing
expect Loads: 4
expect Value: local
tap id:resolve
expect State: ready
expect Value: user 3 again
# An unset source loads nothing.
tap id:clear
absent Loads: 5
absent Loading: yes
expect Loads: 4
expect Aborts: 1
expect State: ready
expect Value: user 3 again
# A resource whose component goes away aborts its load.
tap id:hide
expect Child gone
absent Child: pending
expect Child aborts: 1
